
'''Kawachi Ō''' (河内王, dates of birth and death unknown) was a {{ill|Prince of Japan|ja|日本の王 (皇族)}} during the {{ill|Nara period|en|Nara period|qid=Q189178|lt=Nara period}}. He held the Rank of {{ill|Senior Fifth Rank|ja|正五位下|lt=Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}} and served as Governor of {{ill|Tango Province|en|Tango Province|qid=Q1054331|lt=Tango Province}}.

== Career ==
In the court of {{ill|Emperor Shōmu|en|Emperor Shōmu|qid=Q349263|lt=Emperor Shōmu}} during the ninth year of the {{ill|Tenpyō|en|Tenpyō|qid=Q1199879|lt=Tenpyō}} era (737), Kawachi Ō was directly promoted from no Rank to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位下|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade}}. 

In the second year of the {{ill|Tenpyō-hōji|en|Tenpyō-hōji|qid=Q1346307|lt=Tenpyō-hōji}} era (758), during the enthronement of Emperor {{ill|Emperor Junnin|en|Emperor Junnin|qid=Q329713|lt=Junnin}}, Kawachi Ō was dispatched to perform rituals at the {{ill|Ise Grand Shrine|en|Ise Shrine|qid=Q687168|lt=Ise Grand Shrine}} alongside {{ill|Nakatomi no Ikemori|ja|中臣池守|qid=DELETED_QID}} and others. At the time, his official position was {{ill|Head of the Left Bureau of Imperial Attendants|ja|左大舎人頭}}.<ref>『続日本紀』天平宝字2nd year 8月19日条</ref> 

In the third year of the Tenpyō Hōji era (759), he received his first promotion in 22 years to {{ill|Junior Fifth Rank|ja|従五位上|lt=Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade}}. In the fourth year (760), he was appointed as {{ill|Assistant Minister of Justice|ja|義部大輔}}, and in the sixth year (762), he became Governor of Tango Province. However, he appears to have been implicated in the {{ill|Fujiwara no Nakamaro Rebellion|en|Fujiwara no Nakamaro Rebellion|qid=Q11623017|lt=Fujiwara no Nakamaro Rebellion}} in the eighth year (764), resulting in the loss of his Rank and position.

In the first year of the {{ill|Hōki|en|Hōki|qid=Q18520676|lt=Hōki}} era (770), upon the enthronement of Emperor {{ill|Emperor Kōnin|ar|الإمبراطور كونين|arz|الامبراطور كونين|azb|کونین (ایمپیراتور)|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر کۆنین|cs|Kónin|de|Kōnin|es|Kōnin Tennō|eu|Kōnin enperadorea|fa|امپراتور کونین|fi|Kōnin|fr|Kōnin|hu|Kónin japán császár|id|Kaisar Kōnin|it|Kōnin|ja|光仁天皇|ko|고닌 천황|mn|Эзэн Хаан Коонин|mr|कोनिन|nl|Konin (keizer)|pl|Kōnin|pt|Konin|ru|Император Конин|sh|Car Kōnin|simple|Emperor Kōnin|sl|Cesar Konin|sv|Kōnin|th|จักรพรรดิโคนิง|tl|Emperador Kōnin|tr|Kōnin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Конін|vi|Thiên hoàng Kōnin|yo|Emperor Kōnin|zh|光仁天皇|zh_min_nan|Kônin Thian-hông|qid=Q958662|lt=Kōnin}}, he was reinstated to Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade. In the third year (772), he was promoted to Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade.

== Official Record ==
Based on the {{ill|Shoku Nihongi|ar|شوكو نيهونغي|ca|Shoku Nihongi|cs|Šoku Nihongi|de|Shoku Nihongi|es|Shoku Nihongi|eu|Shoku Nihongi|fa|شوکو نیهونگی|ff|Shoku Nihongi|fr|Shoku Nihongi|id|Shoku Nihongi|it|Shoku Nihongi|ja|続日本紀|ko|속일본기|ms|Shoku Nihongi|pt|Shoku Nihongi|ru|Сёку нихонги|simple|Shoku Nihongi|sl|Šoku Nihongi|th|โชกุนิฮงงิ|tr|Shoku Nihongi|uk|Сьоку Ніхонґі|zh|續日本紀|qid=Q611399|lt=Shoku Nihongi}}:
* {{ill|Tenpyō|en|Tenpyō|qid=Q1199879|lt=Tenpyō}} 9 (737), September 28: Junior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade (direct promotion)
* Tenpyō Hōji 2 (758), August 19: Left Bureau of Imperial Attendants (current position)
* Tenpyō Hōji 3 (759), June 16: Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade
* Tenpyō Hōji 4 (760), January 16: Assistant Minister of Justice
* Tenpyō Hōji 6 (762), January 9: Governor of Tango Province
* Date unknown: Rank and position forfeited
* {{ill|Hōki|en|Hōki|qid=Q18520676|lt=Hōki}} 1 (770), October 1: Junior Fifth Rank, Upper Grade (reinstatement)
* Hōki 3 (772), January 3: Senior Fifth Rank, Lower Grade
